patches.name: Clone with badge
patches.description: Installable copy of the app under a new package name, with its own label, a recolored and numbered icon, and a corner pill showing the number in-app.

options.description: Package name of the copy. Must differ from the original and from every other copy.
Number shown in the corner pill and stamped on the icon (1-9).
Launcher icon background color (#RRGGBB), also used for the digit on the icon.

patches.name: Keep playback on activity destroy
patches.description: Keeps background playback and its media foreground service alive when the system destroys MusicActivity to reclaim memory. A user-initiated close (back press or swipe from recents) still stops playback.

patches.name: Play videos Music marks unavailable
patches.description: Plays a video that YouTube Music's own player API refuses as "This video is not available" when the client used by Spoof video streams can play it. Needs Spoof video streams; does nothing without it.

patches.name: Seek buttons for long tracks
patches.description: Shows the podcast-style rewind 10 s / forward 30 s buttons in the media notification, for any track longer than a set length.

options.description: Tracks longer than this get the seek buttons.
